{{Wired embedded system |brand=Cisco |model=RV042 |revision=v3 |asin=B0002I7288 |manuf_country=Taiwan |is_manuf=No |type=VPN Router,router |pwr_v=12 |pwr_amp=1 |pwr_conn=barrel |cpu1_brand=Cavium |cpu1_model=CN5010 |cpu1_cspeed=300 |fla1=32 |fla1_brand=Intel |fla1_model=JS28F256-P33BF |ram1=128 |ram1_brand=Samsung |ram1_model=K4T51163QJ-BCE7 |ram1_num=2 |jtag=yes |serial=yes |eth_cpu=true |sw_brand=Realtek |sw_model=RTL8309G |lan_speed=100M |lan_ports=4 |wan_ports=2 |addl_chips=FPGA;Lattice;LCMXO256;Lattice, MachXO, LCMXO256C, 3TN100C;1;,,, 2A, 18V Synchronous Rectified Step-Down Converter;MPS;MP1482DS;;3; |default_ip=192.168.1.1 |default_user=admin |default_pass=admin |oui_eth=F0:F7:55 }} {{TagLine|Cisco RV042 Dual WAN VPN Router}} :[http://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/routers/rv042-dual-wan-vpn-router/index.html Product page] "3000-RV4241G90" and "Manufactured for CISCO" is silkscreened on the board. ===Teardown=== *[https://www.natthapol89.com/2014/10/cisco-rv042-v3.html ''Cisco RV042 v3'' Teardown on '''Natthapol89'''] ===Reviews=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/lanwan/lanwan-reviews/31502-cisco-rv042-v3-dual-wan-vpn-router-reviewed ''Cisco RV042 v3 Dual WAN VPN Router Reviewed'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] :[[Cisco RV042 v3]] is powered by a @300MHz [[Cavium]] CN5010, :replacing the Intel IXP425-266 in the [[Cisco RV042]] V1. :RAM and flash have been bumped up to 128 MB and 32 MB, respectively, :up from 32 MB and 8 MB in the original [[Cisco RV042 (Linksys)]]. *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/lanwan/lanwan-reviews/31525-cisco-rv082-and-rv016-v3-vpn-routers-reviewed ''Cisco RV082 and RV016 v3 VPN Routers Reviewed'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] :Like the RV042, the original 016 and 082 used an Intel IXP425-266 :processor with 16 MB of flash and 64 and 32 MB of RAM, respectively
